info.title: Lealmi Agent API
info.description: Machine-to-machine API for AI agents, POS systems, and automation platforms. Authenticate with X-Agent-Key header.

get.summary: List all members platform-wide
get.description: Returns paginated members across all partners. Supports search and active filtering. Admin-only.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by name, email, or unique identifier

get.summary: Get member details with card balances
get.description: Returns member details with their card enrollments and point balances. Admin-only.

get.summary: Get platform-wide analytics
get.description: Returns aggregated platform metrics including partner, member, and transaction counts.

get.summary: Get per-partner analytics
get.description: Returns usage metrics for a specific partner.

get.summary: List all partners
get.description: Returns paginated partners with optional filters. Admin-only endpoint.

get.summary: Get a specific partner with permissions and usage
get.description: Returns partner details including permissions, limits, and usage counts.

200.description: Partner details with permissions and usage

patch.description: Updates feature flags and resource limits for a partner.

200.description: Permissions updated — returns the full permission set after save

post.description: Deactivates a partner. All associated agent keys become invalid.

get.summary: Check API health and key identity
get.description: Returns the authenticated key's identity, role, scopes, rate limit, and owner information. Use this as a connectivity and configuration check before calling business endpoints.

get.summary: Discover available API tools for this key
get.description: Returns tool definitions scoped to the authenticated key's role and permissions. Use the format parameter to get definitions compatible with your agent framework. This endpoint is excluded from its own tool list.

200.description: Tool definitions for the authenticated key

get.summary: Get all card balances for this member
get.description: Returns the member's point balance across all enrolled loyalty cards in one call.

get.summary: List all enrolled loyalty cards
get.description: Returns paginated loyalty cards that the member has transacted with.

get.summary: Get a single enrolled loyalty card
get.description: Returns a card's details and the member's balance on it.

get.summary: Get transaction history across all cards
get.description: Returns paginated transaction history for the authenticated member.

get.summary: Get transaction history for a specific card
get.description: Returns paginated transaction history for the member on a specific enrolled card.

get.summary: Browse discoverable loyalty cards, stamp cards, and vouchers
get.description: Returns all cards visible on the homepage. Includes loyalty cards, stamp cards, and vouchers that are active and visible by default.

post.summary: Resolve a card URL or identifier to its details
post.description: Accepts a QR code URL, UUID, or unique identifier and returns the corresponding card details. Primary endpoint for QR code scanning.

url.description: Full URL from a QR code or shared link

identifier.description: UUID or unique identifier (alternative to url)

post.summary: Save a card to My Cards (follow)
post.description: Saves a loyalty card to the member's collection. Idempotent — following an already-followed card is a no-op.

post.summary: Remove a card from My Cards (unfollow)
post.description: Removes a loyalty card from the member's collection.

get.summary: List available rewards for this member
get.description: Returns rewards available on the member's enrolled cards with affordability info.

post.description: Submits a claim for a reward. Does NOT deduct points directly — staff must confirm via the dashboard or partner API.

get.summary: Get the authenticated member's profile
get.description: Returns the member's own profile including name, email, locale, avatar, and interaction status.

put.description: Updates limited profile fields (name, locale). Email cannot be changed via agent API.

get.summary: List all loyalty cards for this partner
get.description: Returns paginated loyalty cards owned by the authenticated partner. Supports pagination via page and per_page query parameters.

post.description: Creates a loyalty card with the specified points economy configuration. Requires the club_id of an existing club owned by this partner.

get.summary: Get a specific loyalty card
get.description: Returns a single loyalty card by ID. The card must belong to the authenticated partner.

put.description: Updates a loyalty card owned by the authenticated partner. Only provided fields are updated.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a loyalty card owned by the authenticated partner.

get.summary: List all clubs for this partner
get.description: Returns paginated clubs owned by the authenticated partner.

post.description: Creates a club owned by the authenticated partner.

get.summary: Get a specific club
get.description: Returns a single club by ID. The club must belong to the authenticated partner.

put.description: Updates a club owned by the authenticated partner. Only provided fields are updated.

delete.description: Deletes a club owned by the authenticated partner. Protected clubs cannot be deleted.

get.summary: List members who interacted with this partner
get.description: Returns paginated members that have transactions with this partner's cards. Searchable by name, email, member number, or unique identifier.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by name, email, member number, or unique identifier

get.summary: Get a specific member
get.description: Returns member details. Accepts UUID as path parameter. Member must have interacted with this partner's cards.

get.summary: Get a member's balance on a specific card
get.description: Returns the member's point balance for a specific loyalty card. Both the member and card must belong to this partner.

get.summary: List all rewards for this partner
get.description: Returns paginated rewards owned by the authenticated partner. Requires loyalty cards feature to be enabled.

post.description: Creates a reward that members can claim by spending loyalty points.

points.description: Points required to claim this reward

get.summary: Get a specific reward
get.description: Returns a single reward by ID. The reward must belong to the authenticated partner.

put.description: Updates a reward owned by the authenticated partner. Only provided fields are updated.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a reward owned by the authenticated partner.

get.summary: List all staff members for this partner
get.description: Returns paginated staff members owned by the authenticated partner.

post.description: Creates a staff member who can perform loyalty operations.

get.summary: Get a specific staff member
get.description: Returns a single staff member by ID.

put.description: Updates a staff member owned by the authenticated partner.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a staff member owned by the authenticated partner.

get.summary: List all stamp cards for this partner
get.description: Returns paginated stamp cards owned by the authenticated partner.

post.description: Creates a stamp card with the specified configuration. Requires stamp cards feature to be enabled.

get.summary: Get a specific stamp card
get.description: Returns a single stamp card by ID.

put.description: Updates a stamp card owned by the authenticated partner. Only provided fields are updated.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a stamp card owned by the authenticated partner.

post.summary: Add stamps to a member's stamp card
post.description: Awards stamp(s) to a member on the specified stamp card. If the card is completed, a pending reward is created.

member_identifier.description: UUID, email, member number, or unique identifier

post.description: Redeems one pending reward for a member on the specified stamp card. The member must have a completed card with an unclaimed reward.

member_identifier.description: UUID, email, member number, or unique identifier

422.description: No pending reward or redeem failed

get.summary: List all tiers for this partner
get.description: Returns paginated tiers owned by the authenticated partner, ordered by level.

post.description: Creates a loyalty tier within a club.

get.summary: Get a specific tier
get.description: Returns a single tier by ID.

put.description: Updates a tier owned by the authenticated partner.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a tier owned by the authenticated partner.

get.summary: List transactions for this partner
get.description: Returns paginated transactions with optional filters by member, card, event type, and date range.

parameters.name: member_identifier
parameters.description: Filter by member (UUID, email, member number, or unique identifier)

post.summary: Record a purchase and award loyalty points
post.description: Records a purchase transaction. Points awarded are calculated from the card's points_per_currency ratio, or can be set explicitly via the points parameter. The member_identifier accepts UUID, email, member number, or unique identifier.

member_identifier.description: UUID, email, member number, or unique identifier

422.description: Validation error, card inactive, or transaction failed

post.summary: Redeem a reward and deduct loyalty points
post.description: Claims a reward for a member, deducting the required points from their balance. The reward must be linked to the specified card.

member_identifier.description: UUID, email, member number, or unique identifier

422.description: Insufficient points, reward not linked, or redemption failed

get.summary: List all vouchers for this partner
get.description: Returns paginated vouchers owned by the authenticated partner.

post.description: Creates a voucher with the specified type and value. If no code is provided, one is generated automatically.

get.summary: Get a specific voucher
get.description: Returns a single voucher by ID.

put.description: Updates a voucher owned by the authenticated partner. Only provided fields are updated.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a voucher owned by the authenticated partner.

post.summary: Validate a voucher code without redeeming
post.description: Checks if a voucher code is valid for a member and optionally calculates the discount for a given order amount.

member_identifier.description: UUID, email, member number, or unique identifier

order_amount.description: Order amount in cents for discount calculation

post.summary: Redeem a voucher for a member
post.description: Redeems a voucher for a member, applying the discount/bonus and recording the usage. Uses transactional locking to prevent race conditions.

member_identifier.description: UUID, email, member number, or unique identifier

TranslatableString.description: A translatable value. String when Accept-Language is set, object of locale→value when not.

Club.description: A club groups loyalty cards, stamp cards, and vouchers under one brand.

LoyaltyCard.description: A loyalty card defines a points economy: currency, earning rate, limits, and expiry.

Reward.description: A reward that members can claim by spending loyalty points. Linked to cards via pivot table — no card_id on the resource itself.

PartnerTransaction.description: A transaction as seen from the partner perspective. Includes staff and reward attribution.

event.description: Transaction event type (initial_bonus_points, purchase, redemption, etc.)

MemberTransaction.description: A transaction as seen from the member perspective. Omits internal IDs, includes display fields.

MemberSummary.description: A member as seen from the admin perspective. Used by admin list/detail endpoints.

PartnerMemberSummary.description: A member as seen from the partner perspective. Includes more profile fields than the admin view.

StampCard.description: A stamp card with a fixed number of stamp slots and a reward on completion.

stamps_required.description: Number of stamps needed to complete the card

Voucher.description: A voucher with a code, type (discount/reward), and optional usage limits.

Tier.description: A loyalty tier for VIP levels based on points thresholds.

StaffMember.description: A staff member who can perform loyalty operations at the point of sale.

PurchaseResult.description: Result of a purchase transaction with points awarded.

RedemptionResult.description: Result of a reward redemption with points deducted.

MemberProfile.description: The authenticated member's own profile, including interaction status.

MemberCard.description: A loyalty card as seen from the member perspective, including their balance.

balance.description: Member's current point balance on this card

PartnerSummary.description: A partner summary as seen from the admin perspective (list endpoint).

PartnerPermissions.description: Feature flags and resource limits for a partner. Returned by detail and permission update endpoints.

PartnerDetail.description: Full partner details including permissions and usage counts (detail endpoint).

AdminMemberDetail.description: Full member details with card balances (admin detail endpoint).

HealthResponse.description: Health check response with key identity and capabilities.

Pagination.description: Pagination metadata included in all list responses.

AgentError.description: Structured error response with machine-readable retry strategy.

message.example: The request data did not pass validation.

retry_strategy.description: no_retry = permanent failure; backoff = retry with delay; fix_request = fix payload; contact_support = human action needed

AgentKey.description: Agent API key. Prefix indicates role: rl_agent_* (partner), rl_admin_* (admin), rl_member_* (member).
AgentKey.name: X-Agent-Key
